documents.title: Artifact Governance
documents.lead: Rules for stable artifact identities, provenance, lifecycle, authority, fingerprints, replacements, and validity boundaries.
documents.policy: Update when artifact-governance rules change; update the JSON registry whenever a retained artifact is added or reclassified.

documents.title: 产物治理
documents.lead: 规定稳定产物身份、来源、生命周期、权威、指纹、替代物与有效边界。
documents.policy: 产物治理规则变化时更新；保留产物新增或重新分类时更新 JSON 登记表。
